text_en: When I came to you, brothers and sisters, I did not come proclaiming the mystery of God to you in lofty words or wisdom.
text_cn: 弟兄们，就是我从前到你们那里时，也没有用高超的言论或智慧，给你们宣讲天主的奥义，

text_en: For I decided to know nothing among you except Jesus Christ, and him crucified.
text_cn: 因为我曾决定，在你们中不知道别的，只知道耶稣基督，这被钉在十字架上的耶稣基督；

text_en: And I came to you in weakness and in fear and in much trembling.
text_cn: 而且当我到你们那里的时候，又软弱，又恐惧，又战兢不安；

text_en: My speech and my proclamation were not with plausible words of wisdom, but with a demonstration of the Spirit and of power,
text_cn: 并且我的言论和我的宣讲，并不在于智慧动听的言词，而是在于圣神和他德能的表现，

text_en: so that your faith might rest not on human wisdom but on the power of God.
text_cn: 为使你们的信德不是凭人的智慧，而是凭天主的德能。

text_en: Yet among the mature we do speak wisdom, though it is not a wisdom of this age or of the rulers of this age, who are doomed to perish.
text_cn: 我们在成全的人中也讲智慧，不过不是今世的智慧，也不是今世将要消灭的有权势者的智慧；

text_en: But we speak God’s wisdom, secret and hidden, which God decreed before the ages for our glory.
text_cn: 我们所讲的，乃是那隐藏的，天主奥秘的智慧，这智慧是天主在万世之前，为使我们获得光荣所预定的；

text_en: None of the rulers of this age understood this; for if they had, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.
text_cn: 今世有权势的人中没有一个认识她，因为如果他们认识了，决不至于将光荣的主钉在十字架上。

text_en: But, as it is written, “What no eye has seen, nor ear heard, nor the human heart conceived, what God has prepared for those who love him”—
text_cn: 经上这样记载说：“天主为爱他的人所准备的，是眼所未见，耳所未闻，人心所未想到的。”

text_en: these things God has revealed to us through the Spirit; for the Spirit searches everything, even the depths of God.
text_cn: 可是天主藉着圣神将这一切启示给我们了，因为圣神洞察一切，就连天主的深奥事理他也洞悉。

text_en: For what human being knows what is truly human except the human spirit that is within? So also no one comprehends what is truly God’s except the Spirit of God.
text_cn: 除了人内里的心神外，有谁能知道那人的事呢？同样，除了天主圣神外，谁也不能明了天主的事。

text_en: Now we have received not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit that is from God, so that we may understand the gifts bestowed on us by God.
text_cn: 我们所领受的，不是这世界的精神，而是出于天主的圣神，为使我们能明了天主所赐与我们的一切。

text_en: And we speak of these things in words not taught by human wisdom but taught by the Spirit, interpreting spiritual things to those who are spiritual.
text_cn: 为此，我们宣讲，并不用人的智慧所教的言词，而是用圣神所教的言词，给属神的人讲论属神的事。

text_en: Those who are unspiritual do not receive the gifts of God’s Spirit, for they are foolishness to them, and they are unable to understand them because they are spiritually discerned.
text_cn: 然而属血气的人，不能领受天主圣神的事，因为为他是愚妄；他也不能领悟，因为这些事只有藉圣神才可审断。

text_en: Those who are spiritual discern all things, and they are themselves subject to no one else’s scrutiny.
text_cn: 惟有属神的人能审断一切，但他却不为任何人所审断。

text_en: “For who has known the mind of the Lord so as to instruct him? ” But we have the mind of Christ.
text_cn: 经上说：“谁知道上主的心意，去指教他呢？”可是我们有基督的心意。
